collection.description: A teenager realizes that a close friend has quietly stopped receiving invitations to group games.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (teen) realizes that (friend) has quietly stopped receiving invitations to group games.

choices.label: Speak to the Group Without Naming Names
Invite the Friend to a Small Activity

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (friend) admits feeling excluded, and (teen) listens without making promises for everyone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The group adopts a habit of extending invitations more widely.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some friends become defensive, prompting a slower conversation about unintentional exclusion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (friend) declines but appreciates an invitation without pressure.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (teen) remembers overlooking an earlier message and offers a sincere apology.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (teen) realizes that friendship cannot be managed for someone else and respects their choice.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: (friend) explains they have been exhausted and appreciate being asked.
